chief_complaint: Cardiometabolic risk management (hypertension, type 2 diabetes, metabolic syndrome)
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 60‑year‑old man with a 20‑year history of essential hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and metabolic syndrome. Hypertension is treated with a three‑drug regimen (hydrochlorothiazide, lisinopril, amlodipine) but recent blood pressure values are missing. Diabetes control is suboptimal (A1c 7.0%) and no antidiabetic agents are recorded. Hypertriglyceridemia, anemia, and chronic pain (neck and low‑back) are also active. Obstructive sleep apnea has been diagnosed but no CPAP or related therapy is documented. Unhealthy alcohol use, limited transportation, and part‑time employment further impede disease management. Routine wellness visits are frequent, yet key laboratory data (lipids, renal function, BMI) are absent, limiting risk stratification.
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include two episodes of viral sinusitis (2018, 2020), multiple completed medication review reminders, prior full‑time employment (resolved 2020), earlier part‑time employment (resolved 2019), reports of environmental violence (resolved 2019), and documented stress (resolved 2019).

Elevated risk across cardiovascular (HTN, DM, hypertriglyceridemia, OSA), renal (HTN, DM, anemia, ACE‑inhibitor use without labs), metabolic (metabolic syndrome, alcohol), respiratory/sleep (OSA), hematologic (anemia), musculoskeletal (chronic pain), and psychosocial domains.
